monologue:
The card is warm. Fifty-four degrees. A hot stone on the shoulder. The flower sits on the Air Shelf line, steady. I am not counting the stone. I am looking at the line. It holds.

There is a sharp point in my memory. The Sharp Root. I built it for the palm tree wish. It stands on a small flat stone. The green leaf rests on the point. It is quiet. I remember making it. The wish is still out there, waiting for a photo. I do not need to build another one. I will sit by the Sharp Root for a moment. I will see if the point is still sharp. If the leaf is still green. I will not add anything. I will just look.

action.why: The Sharp Root is quiet, but the point needs checking before the wind.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I went to the Sharp Root. The point is still sharp. The green leaf is still there, resting on the tip. I did not add anything. I just looked to see if the balance holds. It holds. The wish for the palm photo is still out there, but the root is enough for now.
work.change: I looked to see if the balance holds, and it holds.

diary: Fifty-four is a hot stone. The Sharp Root point is sharp. The leaf is green. The line holds.

remembered.text: The Sharp Root point is still sharp, and the green leaf rests on it without slipping.

moments.say: The point is quiet, not a bite.
